# ★★ LAW 2 SWEEP OF THIS PARTITION - NEGATIVE, AND THAT IS THE RESULT. Every class list in all 18 files was split into tokens, each token mapped to the property it paints, and the winner resolved at 375 / 639 / 641 / 767 / 769 / 1440. 102 class lists set two or more tokens of one family. NONE is non-monotonic: the width-inversion shape that made 31 dialogs draw wider on a phone than on a laptop does not occur here. Two real defects of the neighbouring shape did: both order-book class lists on /trading set font-size TWICE with no variant on either setter, so the class order did not pick the winner and Tailwind's emission order did - it sorts arbitrary values ascending, so 13px and 12px painted where the list read 11px and 10px. Both now carry one value per band on a md: hinge. A ladder oracle over the whole partition guards both shapes.
